bobDecision.summary: Direct upgrade to Node 20 is recommended with no production blockers

prioritizedRisks: Test fixtures contain deprecated patterns that should be updated for consistency
No engines field in package.json to enforce Node version requirements
chosenSolutions: Add engines field to root package.json specifying Node >=20
Update CI/CD pipelines to use Node 20
Optionally clean up test fixtures to align with Node 20 best practices
tradeoffs: Test fixtures will continue to work but contain deprecated patterns
No staged upgrade needed since there are no compatibility blockers
